description: This Java class represents a Score entity for a game application, specifically modeling a game session's score with associated metadata such as player name, score, duration, and timestamp. It is annotated with JPA annotations for ORM mapping to a relational database table named 'scores', including indexes on key columns for query optimization.

classes.name: Score
classes.description: Entity class representing a game score with fields for id, playerName, score, duration, and creation timestamp, along with constructors, accessors, and JPA lifecycle methods.

methods.name: Score
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize all fields.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: JPA callback method to set createdAt to current timestamp if not already set before persisting.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the autogenerated ID of the score record.

methods.name: getPlayerName
methods.description: Returns the player's name associated with the score.

methods.name: getDurationMs
methods.description: Returns the game session duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the score was created.
